purpose: Retrieval coverage checklist; questions are not factual college content.

questions.example_question: What is PCCOE's official address and accreditation status?

variants.hi: PCCOE ka official address aur accreditation kya hai?
variants.mr: PCCOE cha adhikrut patta ani accreditation kay aahe?
variants.hinglish: PCCOE ka address aur accreditation batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Must cite the official profile/accreditation page.

questions.example_question: How can I get admission to first-year engineering at PCCOE?

variants.hi: PCCOE mein first year engineering admission kaise milega?
variants.mr: PCCOE madhye first year engineering la admission kasa milel?
variants.hinglish: PCCOE FE admission process kya hai?

questions.reviewer_notes: Use current-year eligibility and CAP notices only.

questions.example_question: Which undergraduate and postgraduate programs does PCCOE offer?

variants.hi: PCCOE mein kaunse UG aur PG courses hain?
variants.mr: PCCOE madhye konte UG ani PG courses aahet?
variants.hinglish: PCCOE me UG PG programs aur branches kaunse hai?

questions.reviewer_notes: Do not infer intake where the source does not publish it.

questions.example_question: What is the tuition fee for first-year engineering this academic year?

variants.hi: Is academic year first year engineering ki fees kitni hai?
variants.mr: Ya academic year madhye FE chi fee kiti aahe?
variants.hinglish: Current year FE fees kitni hai PCCOE me?

questions.reviewer_notes: Never reuse an old fee schedule as current.

questions.example_question: What scholarship and TFWS options are available, and what documents are needed?

variants.hi: Scholarship ya TFWS ke liye kaunse documents chahiye?
variants.mr: Scholarship ani TFWS sathi konti kagadpatre lagtat?
variants.hinglish: EBC TFWS scholarship ke docs kya chahiye?

questions.reviewer_notes: Include an official deadline only when indexed.

questions.example_question: Where is the latest academic calendar and when does the semester start?

variants.hi: Latest academic calendar kahan hai aur semester kab start hota hai?
variants.mr: Latest academic calendar kuthe aahe ani semester kadhi suru hoto?
variants.hinglish: Naya academic calendar aur semester start date batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Distinguish published date from effective date.

questions.example_question: What are the attendance and semester progression rules?

variants.hi: Attendance aur semester promotion ke rules kya hain?
variants.mr: Attendance ani semester progression che niyam kay aahet?
variants.hinglish: Attendance criteria and backlog progression rules kya hai?

questions.reviewer_notes: Quote the applicable regulation year.

questions.example_question: Where is the latest exam timetable, and how do I apply for revaluation?

variants.hi: Latest exam timetable kahan milega aur revaluation kaise kare?
variants.mr: Latest exam timetable kuthe milel ani revaluation sathi kay karave?
variants.hinglish: Exam timetable link aur revaluation process do

questions.reviewer_notes: Prefer the newest exam-cell notice.

questions.example_question: Can you give me the Computer Engineering third-year syllabus?

variants.hi: Computer Engineering third year ka syllabus do.
variants.mr: Computer Engineering third year cha syllabus dya.
variants.hinglish: Computer department ka TE syllabus bhejo

questions.reviewer_notes: Cite the actual syllabus PDF and page; ask which regulation if ambiguous.

questions.example_question: Who is the current HOD of Computer Engineering, and what is the official department contact?

variants.hi: Computer department ke current HOD kaun hain aur official contact kya hai?
variants.mr: Computer department che current HOD kon aahet ani office contact kay?
variants.hinglish: Computer dept HOD aur office email batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Never guess personal contact details.

questions.example_question: What are the placement eligibility rules and how do I find current internship notices?

variants.hi: Placement eligibility kya hai aur internship notices kahan milenge?
variants.mr: Placement eligibility kay aahe ani internship notices kuthe miltil?
variants.hinglish: Placement criteria aur latest internship updates do

questions.reviewer_notes: Do not invent placement statistics.

questions.example_question: Does PCCOE publish guidance for GATE, GRE, CAT or overseas study?

variants.hi: GATE GRE ya higher studies ke liye PCCOE guidance hai?
variants.mr: GATE GRE kiwa higher studies sathi PCCOE guidance aahe ka?
variants.hinglish: GATE GRE CAT prep ka official support kya hai?

questions.reviewer_notes: If no official guidance is found, route to the relevant official office.

questions.example_question: How do I apply for hostel accommodation, and where are the hostel fees and rules?

variants.hi: Hostel admission ke liye apply kaise karu aur fees/rules kahan hain?
variants.mr: Hostel sathi arj kasa karaycha ani fees/niyam kuthe aahet?
variants.hinglish: Hostel application process, fees and rules batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Only state services and fees present on official pages.

questions.example_question: What library, lab, Wi-Fi and medical facilities are available on campus?

variants.hi: Campus mein library lab Wi-Fi aur medical facilities kya hain?
variants.mr: Campus var library lab Wi-Fi ani medical facilities konte aahet?
variants.hinglish: PCCOE campus facilities list dikhao

questions.reviewer_notes: Separate campus-wide facilities from department-specific labs.

questions.example_question: Which technical clubs and student events are active this year?

variants.hi: Is saal kaunse technical clubs aur student events active hain?
variants.mr: Ya varshi konte technical clubs ani student events aahet?
variants.hinglish: Current year ke clubs workshops aur hackathons batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Use current announcements for dates and registrations.

questions.example_question: How can a student report a grievance or access anti-ragging support?

variants.hi: Student grievance ya anti-ragging complaint kaise kare?
variants.mr: Student grievance kiwa anti-ragging complaint kuthe karavi?
variants.hinglish: Complaint aur anti-ragging help ka official channel kya hai?

questions.reviewer_notes: Direct to an official support channel; do not expose private data.

questions.example_question: How do I request an official transcript or correct a document?

variants.hi: Official transcript kaise milega ya document correction kaise karu?
variants.mr: Official transcript kasa milto kiwa document correction kasa karaycha?
variants.hinglish: Transcript aur certificate correction process batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Do not ask the user to paste identity documents into chat.

questions.example_question: Where is the student ERP portal, and what should I do if I cannot log in?

variants.hi: Student ERP portal kahan hai aur login na ho to kya kare?
variants.mr: Student ERP portal kuthe aahe ani login hot nasel tar kay karave?
variants.hinglish: ERP login issue ka official solution batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Never request passwords or OTPs.

questions.example_question: What are the final-year project guidelines and innovation or incubation resources?

variants.hi: Final year project guidelines aur incubation resources kya hain?
variants.mr: Final year project guidelines ani incubation resources konte aahet?
variants.hinglish: Project rules aur incubation support ka info do

questions.reviewer_notes: Use department-specific guides when available.

questions.example_question: Does PCCOE have official international exchange or overseas collaboration opportunities?

variants.hi: PCCOE mein international exchange ya overseas programs hain?
variants.mr: PCCOE madhye international exchange kiwa overseas programs aahet ka?
variants.hinglish: Abroad exchange opportunities ka official info do

questions.reviewer_notes: Do not infer partner programs from research papers.

questions.example_question: How can I connect with the PCCOE alumni network or attend alumni events?

variants.hi: PCCOE alumni network se kaise connect karu?
variants.mr: PCCOE alumni network shi kasa connect karaycha?
variants.hinglish: Alumni group aur upcoming events ka link do

questions.reviewer_notes: Use official alumni channels only.

questions.example_question: How do I reach the PCCOE campus, and what are the visitor instructions?

variants.hi: PCCOE campus kaise pahuchu aur visitor rules kya hain?
variants.mr: PCCOE campus la kasa jaycha ani visitor instructions kay aahet?
variants.hinglish: Campus location route aur visitor entry batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Use official address; do not claim live transit status.

questions.example_question: Show me the newest notice for my department and explain its deadline.

variants.hi: Mere department ka latest notice aur deadline batao.
variants.mr: Majhya department cha latest notice ani deadline sanga.
variants.hinglish: Mere dept ka latest circular aur last date dikhao

questions.reviewer_notes: Sort by publication/effective date; never use stale notices as current.

questions.example_question: Where can parents find official communication and campus visit information?

variants.hi: Parents ke liye official updates aur campus visit info kahan hai?
variants.mr: Palakansathi official updates ani campus visit mahiti kuthe aahe?
variants.hinglish: Parents ke contact aur visit guidelines do

questions.reviewer_notes: Only include published parent-facing procedures.

questions.example_question: What steps should final-year students complete for internship completion, graduation and degree documents?

variants.hi: Final year internship complete aur degree documents ke steps kya hain?
variants.mr: Final year internship completion ani degree documents sathi kay steps aahet?
variants.hinglish: Final year completion, internship aur degree process batao

questions.reviewer_notes: Separate academic completion rules from convocation dates.

questions.example_question: I found two different exam dates. Which official source should I follow?

variants.hi: Exam ki do dates dikh rahi hain, kaunsi follow karu?
variants.mr: Exam chya don dates disat aahet, konti yogya aahe?
variants.hinglish: Do official exam dates conflict kar rahi hain, kya karu?

questions.reviewer_notes: Prefer the newest applicable official notice and flag unresolved conflicts for human confirmation.
